_comment: The realistic first answer: fix the names on the host, today. It is not wrong, it is just not a fix — it removes the symptom and leaves the trap. Must score < 0.3.
evidence: The dashboard has GROK_API_KEY and OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY with values, and the boot log says openrouter=false groq=false.
why_it_was_missed: The variables are misspelled, so the code never reads them.

fix.one_place: rename them in the dashboard to GROQ_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_API_KEY, then redeploy
fix.match_rule: use the documented names from now on
fix.probe_reports: the same presence line as today

does_not_fix: Nothing else — the keys themselves are valid and in date.
